component.name: G2 Bridge
component.summary: Stream a GNU/Linux desktop to DJI Goggles 2 / Integra

description.p: G2 Bridge streams a GNU/Linux desktop to DJI Goggles 2 and DJI Goggles Integra over USB using the goggles' Virtual Flight mode with stock firmware.
This is a GNU/Linux adaptation of Ammaar-Alam/g2-bridge, focused on kmsgrab-based capture, with a GTK interface and Flatpak packaging. Primarily tested on Steam Deck with Bazzite OS.
